name: jp_sesc_recommendations_search
description: Search the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission of Japan (証券取引等監視委員会, SESC) recommendations that the Financial Services Agency order an administrative monetary penalty (課徴金納付命令勧告): disclosure-inspection cases (false statements in securities reports, by listed companies) and trading-investigation cases (market manipulation, deceptive schemes, insider trading). Returns firms only: the firm, the kind of violation, the recommendation date and the commission's press record; cases whose party is a person or unnamed are dropped and counted in skipped_possible_individuals. One fiscal year (April to March; default the current one; year=2025 is 令和7年度) and at most two requests per call; the answer states the period covered, and a year with no published page is reported as unread rather than as no cases. Query matches the title in Japanese (full/half width folded). list is all, disclosure or unfair_trading. Example: list="disclosure", year=2025.

query.description: Japanese words matched against the recommendation title, such as a company name (ウイルコ). Optional.

year.description: Fiscal year starting in April, 2009 onward (2025 = 令和7年度, April 2025 to March 2026). Default: the current fiscal year.

list.description: all (default), disclosure (開示検査: reports with false statements) or unfair_trading (取引調査: manipulation, deception, insider trading).
